decision_value_formula: Y_t=(NetCash(HOLD one legal 4h step then pi0)-NetCash(EXIT now))/CurrentNotional
notional_convention: Marked live-position economic value immediately before the decision; exact price/quantity source must be canonically bound before materialization and identical across actions.
single_override_future_policy: First qualified disagreement only; override for one legal step then return to pi0. No intervention contributes zero DirectGain.
